topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I can’t believe they’re even asking. We've barely said more than hello, and now they want a piece of my yard for their little hobby? I keep my lawn perfect, spend every weekend on it. Now I’m supposed to let them dig up a part of it? What’s next, letting the whole neighborhood use my driveway as a park? I’ll have to think about it, sure. I’m not one to rush into things. But honestly, what a nerve. My yard is my space, my project, my responsibility. Not a communal garden.
